title: Strieber's meeting with James Jesus Angleton

tellings.quote: told me on the podcast as well he met with James Jesus Engleton once

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing encounters with strange beings, told him on the show that he once met James Jesus Angleton, a senior figure in the CIA, the US spy agency. No time or place is given, but if true it would link Strieber's story to the highest levels of American intelligence.
